n6_gap_found.gap: TLS half of the search-auth fix was UNTESTED. The production wiring (TrackerClientModule.provideTrackerRegistry) hands ApiBackedTrackerClient the @Named("lan") permissive-TLS OkHttpClient so the self-signed LAN api-go cert handshakes; the strict/system-trust unqualified client SSLHandshakeException-fails → 'Something went wrong'. No existing test asserted this binding: ApiBackedTrackerClientTest + DynamicRegistryRealClientTest build the client with their own plain OkHttpClient(); LanTlsContractTest proves the @Named("lan") client is permissive but NOT that the registry is wired with it. A refactor dropping @Named("lan") (reverting to the strict client = the original bug) would stay green across the whole suite — a §6.J bluff vector.
n6_gap_found.closed_by: core/tracker/client/src/test/kotlin/lava/tracker/client/LanHttpClientWiringContractTest.kt (new). Reflectively asserts provideTrackerRegistry's sole OkHttpClient parameter carries @Named("lan") (javax.inject.Named is @Retention(RUNTIME)) and that no unqualified OkHttpClient parameter exists.

falsifiability_rehearsal.mutation: Removed @Named("lan") from the lanHttpClient parameter of provideTrackerRegistry (reverting to the strict unqualified client).
